task.pr_title: Add support for loading Fortran contiguous tensors

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: I think this would only work for tensors that have a "symmetrical" shape. If the shape using the fortran layout is `[d1, d2, d3]`, we should first reshape the tensor that was read assuming C layout to shape `[d3, d2, d1]` and then permute the dimensions.

evidence.thread_resolution: antimora: Good catch. I have updated it now to cover other cases. I also added a unit test to confirm it works for that case.
